item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from openpyxl import load_workbook
p='inputs/Proteomic_data .xlsx'
for data_only in [False,True]:
 print('DATA_ONLY',data_only)
 wb=load_workbook(p,read_only=True,data_only=data_only)
 print('sheets',wb.sheetnames)
 for ws in wb.worksheets:
  print('SHEET',repr(ws.title),'dims',ws.max_row,ws.max_column)
  for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1,max_row=min(ws.max_row,12),values_only=True):
   print(repr(row[:15]))
  print('ENO1 matches:')
  n=0
  for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
   if any('ENO1' in str(v).upper() for v in row if v is not None):
    print(repr(row[:25])); n+=1
  print('count',n)
PY"

item.text: ENO1 appears once (UniProt P06733). Its tumor abundance is 350,385,456.45 versus 72,896,133.29 in normal, giving a tumor/normal ratio of about 4.8067; the workbook reports this fold change rounded to 4.81.
